site_account.title: Tessellate Payroll: payroll for agencies
site_account.description: Pay your staff and your freelancers from one place. Built for creative agencies with 10 to 80 people. Live in a week, one price.
site_account.markdown:
# Payroll for agencies, staff and freelancers alike

Tessellate runs payroll for your employees and payments to your contractors from one account.

## One price, no tiers

A flat monthly price per person paid, whether they are on staff or on contract.

## Live in a week

Most agencies run their first payroll within seven days of signing up.

site_1.title: Paymint: payroll, benefits and HR for small business
site_1.description: Run payroll in minutes, add health benefits and keep HR paperwork in one place. One low monthly price, no sales call needed.
site_1.markdown:
# Payroll, benefits and HR in one place

Paymint gives small businesses payroll, benefits and the HR basics in one self-serve product.

## One low monthly price

A base fee plus a small amount per employee. Sign up online in ten minutes.

## Add benefits when you are ready

Health, dental and retirement plans you can turn on from the dashboard.

site_2.title: Stackwage: the payroll and HR platform for growing companies
site_2.description: Payroll, HR, benefits and compliance for mid-market companies. Choose the platform or let our PEO take on the employer burden.
site_2.markdown:
# Built for companies that are growing up

Stackwage is the payroll and HR platform for mid-market companies, with a PEO option for teams that want us to carry the employer burden.

## Talk to sales

Our team will scope your rollout and build a plan for your company.

## Trusted at scale

Thousands of companies run payroll on Stackwage every month.

site_3.title: Crewpay: pay your freelancers
site_3.description: Contractor payments and invoicing for studios and the freelancers they hire. Pay per payment, no subscription.
site_3.markdown:
# Pay the crew

Crewpay handles contractor onboarding, invoices and payments for studios that work with freelancers.

## Pay per payment

No monthly fee. A small charge on each payment you send.

## Freelancers love it

Your contractors get paid on time and keep their own records in Crewpay.

site_4.title: Harbor HR: the complete HR suite with payroll
site_4.description: HR, payroll, performance and benefits for companies with 100 to 2,000 employees. Implemented by our team.
site_4.markdown:
# The HR suite your company grows into

Harbor HR brings payroll, performance, benefits and compliance together for companies with 100 to 2,000 employees.

## Implemented with you

A dedicated implementation manager runs your rollout over eight to twelve weeks.

## Talk to sales

Speak with our sales team about your company.

site_5.title: Quillpay: payroll built for restaurants
site_5.description: Payroll with tip pooling, scheduling and overtime rules built for restaurants and hospitality groups.
site_5.markdown:
# Payroll that understands tips

Quillpay runs payroll for restaurants and hospitality groups, with tip pooling, split shifts and overtime rules built in.

## Scheduling included

Build the week's schedule and let the hours flow straight into payroll.

## For one location or forty

From a single restaurant to a regional group.

site_6.title: Ledgerly Payroll: payroll run by accountants
site_6.description: A named accountant runs your payroll every month. Add bookkeeping when you need it. For small businesses that want a person, not a dashboard.
site_6.markdown:
# Your payroll, run by an accountant

Ledgerly Payroll gives small businesses a named accountant who runs payroll every month and answers the phone.

## Bookkeeping, when you want it

Add monthly bookkeeping from the same accountant.

## A person, not a dashboard

We built Ledgerly for owners who would rather hand it off.

data.headline: Where Tessellate sits among six payroll companies, and the gap none of them fills
data.intro: The six companies are the ones whose profiles are closest to Tessellate. Each one is placed from what its own homepage says about who it sells to and how much it bundles with payroll. The positions are a reading, not a ranking.

open_space.title: Agencies that pay staff and freelancers from one place
open_space.why: Crewpay handles freelancers and Paymint handles staff, and nobody does both for an agency that runs a mix. Quillpay shows that a product built for one trade can hold its own against the generalists. Tessellate already pays both kinds of worker for agencies and could claim the space by saying so on every page.
